UnitStory_110602_4: In the center of the storm, the Original Lord of Helios revealed to Karin the darkest history of the temple: during the ancient War of the Gods, the Helios clan were not simple guardians, but executors who used the Dragon Breath Source to conduct "Light Energy Massacres." Karin firmly believed the light was pure, but her convictions were shattered by the true scenes shown by the Original Lord. The Lord attempted to use the wavering in Karin's heart to transform her into a vessel for the Black Breath. At that moment, the "Clay Idol" she had found when the temple landed suddenly opened its eyes. It blocked a fatal blow for Karin and emitted a warm, inclusive, and non-aggressive "Soft Light." Karin realized that true light should not be a flame that scorches all, but the morning dew that nourishes all things. She reshaped the magic core of her staff and repelled the Original Lord. Before vanishing, the Clay Idol left behind a stone tablet, guiding her to the true location of the "Red Sun Crystal"—the only origin capable of completely neutralizing the Black Breath.
UnitStory_110602_5: Karin joined forces with Starstreak and Serena, forming a unique expeditionary force to march toward the forbidden lands deep within the volcano. Here, they faced a "Dark Council" composed of demon lords and fallen warriors. Karin's light became the team's sturdiest support, but during a deep underground assault, she accidentally fell into a Black Breath pool. In that viscous fluid filled with negative emotions, Karin saw the residual consciousness of countless former Saintesses; they were weeping and cursing this unfair world. Karin was not submerged by hatred but used her newly realized "Light of Mercy" to soothe these suffering souls. This unexpected action caused the entire Black Breath pool to instantly solidify into golden crystals. However, when she climbed out of the crystal pool, she found her teammates surrounded, and Livia (the Fire Princess) was controlling an ancient dragon corrupted by Black Breath, preparing to unleash a breath of destruction upon them.
UnitStory_110602_6: In a magnificent aerial showdown, Karin concentrated all the remaining energy of the Helios Temple at the tip of her staff, turning it into a massive spear of light that pierced through the Black Breath Dragon. Before its death, the dragon let out a cry of relief, and the silhouette of the Red Sun Crystal emerged from the ashes. Just as Karin prepared to take the crystal, a bolt of pitch-black "Judgment Lightning" descended from the sky—an upper-tier predator from the Sea of Void had sensed the awakening of the crystal. The powerful impact fractured Karin's legs and even broke her staff into two pieces. Amidst the wreckage, Karin looked at her comrades who had fallen to protect the crystal, and a steadfastness ignited in her heart like never before. She used the broken staff to prop up her body and dripped her own blood into the crystal. In an instant, a "Great Fusion Power" that transcended race and light and shadow erupted from the crystal, completely reshaping Karin's body into a translucent body of golden jade.
UnitStory_110602_7: The final battle took place at the very peak of the Dragon Breath Continent. Karin was no longer that aloof temple priestess but a true Saintess of the Earth. She channeled the power of the Red Sun Crystal into the energy grid of the entire continent, instantly extinguishing all frenzied flames of Black Breath and dispelling the void shadows attempting to invade. The world finally welcomed a long-awaited peace. Karin returned to the Helios Temple, which had now landed on the ground, and transformed it into an open "Healing Center of Light." Though her strength was exhausted and she could only spend her days in a wheelchair, her eyes reflected the hope of the entire Dragon Breath Continent's rebirth. One day, the long-disappeared Clay Idol appeared before her window again, handing her a small flower she had never seen before that glowed at night. Karin took the flower and smiled as she looked out the window. Though the threat of the Black Breath was gone, that "Eye" from the depths of the star-sea, flickering in the sunlight, suggested that a new era had only just begun. And the Pharaoh would forever watch over this land...
UnitStory_110202_2: In the Rune City of the Valen Federation, Elina Brighthelm stood before her family's ancient warrior banner, her heart ignited by a powerful sense of mission. Born into a storied family of warriors, her kin had personally witnessed the rebuilding after the Ancient Gods' War and bore the duty of protecting human civilization. Yet as a child, she saw the bloody conflicts erupt between the orc tribes of the southern wastelands vying for the “Dragonbreath Crystal,” shattering her hopeful vision of the future. Her parents were lost in the strife, leaving a deep scar on young Elina's soul. “I swear no more innocent lives will be caught in war!” she silently vowed, determined to become a mighty warrior defending against darkness and chaos with her sword. Driven by this resolve, she trained rigorously within the Runeschool, mastering swordsmanship, rune technology, and defensive magic, quickly revealing her prowess.
UnitStory_110202_3: At her warrior initiation, Elina donned shining armor, clutching the sword symbolizing her family's legacy, stepping forward with unwavering resolve. Yet time passed, and shadow of war still draped over the continent. Tensions escalated on the southern border, orc skirmishes grew fierce, hinting at renewed bloodshed. One day, Elina received orders to investigate the restless orc tribes at the border. She knew she had to uncover the conspiracies and plans behind the conflict to find a chance to halt the war. “History must not repeat itself in my era!” she declared firmly, resolved to embody justice. The honor of her initiation became a driving force; Elina set forth to the border, full of youthful vigor, ready to meet her destiny.
UnitStory_110202_4: At the border town, Elina witnessed villagers ravaged by orc strife. Her heart grew heavy, determined to sever the dark curse with her blade. There, she met several brave warriors likewise devoted to defending their homeland, forming a small but growing team. “We must hold this line—we cannot let war spread,” she asserted with strength and warmth that inspired the fighters deeply. After days of careful planning, they prepared defenses against the looming enemy. As the warriors dedicated themselves, Elina sensed a subtle unease—unseen enemies seemed to close silently. Dark forces promised to complicate matters; she silently repeated: Only by holding faith and reason can balance be found.
UnitStory_110202_5: Night descended, enemy forces drew near. Elina and her companions concealed themselves in defensible, hard-to-breach positions around town. Suddenly, thunderous footsteps advanced—orc armies surged like waves into the city; battle was about to erupt. “Stay calm and ready!” Elina rallied her team, instilling unshakeable courage. She knew any hesitation could give the enemy advantage. Her legendary Sword of Light shimmered in hand, while hopes for the future burned in her heart like flames. The fight began; Elina swung her great sword decisively, unleashing powerful rune magic to repel the surging foes. Though valiant, Elina perceived stronger forces hidden within enemy ranks. An ominous threat approached, signaling a critical turning point in her growth.
UnitStory_110202_6: As battle intensified, Elina spotted a black-robed mage among the enemies, his spells like dark tide surging against the town's defenses. She realized this mage was the key to defeating the enemy force; his intent was clear—to augment orcish might further. “We cannot let him complete his potent magic!” she cried inwardly, ready to confront the raging foe and launch an assault on the mage. She knew the time to unveil the truth had come; only by slaying the mage could the town be freed from darkness. As she raced toward the mage, enemy pressure trapped her. Shadows encircled her—orc warriors surged like a tide. Faced with a choice, Elina had to decide: focus all strength on the mage or split forces to meet a greater threat.
UnitStory_110202_7: Resolutely, Elina chose to concentrate, charging the mage with sword and rune power. She wielded her blade, channeling a tough radiance that struck fiercely at enemies. Thunderous blows rattled the mage, shattering his dark summoning. With a crashing roar, the spell collapsed, and shadowy surroundings dissipated. Remaining foes lost fighting spirit and retreated. The town's vitality restored, Elina's heroic deeds quickly spread, uplifting villagers' spirits. Though victorious, Elina knew more challenges loomed. As a knight and guardian, she vowed to carry her family's legacy forward, protecting peace and justice. She embarked on a new journey, her light guiding lands still shadowed by darkness.
UnitStory_120202_2: Peggy sat on the back of her mount, "Big Tooth," chewing half an apple while boredly watching the busy mines in the dwarven territory. As an outlier among the dwarves, she would rather fight mud snakes in a mud pit than strike iron by the forge. However, today Big Tooth suddenly let out an extremely muffled whimper and even refused his favorite lava fruit. Peggy blew her bone flute, attempting to soothe him, but through the resonance, she felt a "fear" coming from the depths of the souls of all beasts across the continent. It was an extremely ominous vibration, as if some ancient predator that specifically hunts life was awakening. Peggy looked up at the sky and noticed that the originally azure horizon was now shrouded in a faint brownish-gray haze. She patted Big Tooth's head: "Looks like we've got some real work to do." Just as she was about to set out, a falcon wreathed in black smoke plunged from the sky and died at her feet; within the falcon's eyes, a mass of writhing Black Breath was reflected.
UnitStory_120202_3: Peggy tracked the source of the Black Breath falcon to the border between the Holy Forest and the dwarven wastelands. The scene here caused this usually carefree girl to feel a sincere terror. The once-lush forest had become deathly still, and packs of forest wolves had not only grown massive bone spikes but their eyes also glowed with a frenzied red light as they tore each other apart. Peggy blew her bone flute to cast the "All-Beast Rest Ritual," but found that this Black Breath power could directly sever her psychic connection with the beasts. In a skirmish, Big Tooth, while protecting Peggy, had his back armor gouged with deep cracks by a frenzied giant bear. In a moment of despair, a "Dragon-veined Lion Cub," which should have been extinct, appeared before her and dispersed the dark mist with a puff of pure Dragon Breath. The cub seemed to be leading the way, and the direction it led was toward the "Underground Fire Prison," the most forbidden place of the dwarves. Could it be that this Black Breath capable of corrupting beasts was related to her own kin?
UnitStory_120202_4: Peggy infiltrated the dwarven Underground Fire Prison. In the magma layer a thousand meters deep, she witnessed a scene that made her eyes nearly burst: the greed-driven radical factions within her tribe were actually using captured beasts for "Living Armor Experiments." They forcibly implanted Black Breath crystals into the beasts' bodies and welded on hard magitech steel plates, attempting to create a painless, senseless biochemical weapon of war. Watching her companions imprisoned in iron cages, wailing in agony, Peggy's rage instantly broke through her reason. She played a forbidden tune called "Fury of the Wild Beasts," triggering a magical rampage throughout the Fire Prison. However, while releasing the beasts, she discovered that the leader in charge of the experiment was actually her long-lost elder brother. Half of his face under a mask had transformed into a hybrid of machinery and Black Breath. He coldly said to Peggy: "Peggy, the future of the dwarves does not need mercy; it only needs obedience."
UnitStory_120202_5: Facing her brother who had turned into a monster, Peggy fought back her tears and commanded the newly rescued beast legion to launch a breakout. During the fierce battle, her brother piloted a massive armor composed of countless beast bones and machinery—the "Black Breath Matrix." This matrix could not only produce Black Breath mist but also control any conscious creature through electromagnetic frequencies. Peggy's bone flute almost broke under the frequency interference of the matrix, and she was trapped in a collapsing mine tunnel. At that moment, the Dragon-veined Lion Cub sacrificed itself, transforming into a golden mark that merged into Peggy's bone flute. Peggy felt an unprecedented "Dragon's Secret Order," capable of commanding all things in the world, echo in her heart. She played again, and the flute sound turned into substantial light waves, shattering her brother's mechanical armor. In the instant of the explosion, her brother threw her a sealed scroll, which bore the words: "List of Traitors of the Holy Forest Council." What was really going on?
UnitStory_120202_6: Peggy fled the mine tunnels with her scarred beast legion, becoming a target wanted by both the dwarves and the Holy Forest Council. She realized that behind the Black Breath experiments lay deeper political deals—it seemed the high-level officials of each race had reached a tacit understanding, wanting to accelerate civilization's so-called "evolution" through "artificially created crises." During her exile, with the help of Liya from the Plant Race, Peggy began to heal the modified beasts. She tried combining dwarven rune repair technology with natural life magic, creating a "Psionic Collar" that could automatically resist Black Breath erosion. As more and more free beasts joined, Peggy's Beast Legion became the last pure resistance force on the continent. Just then, she received a distress signal from the legendary fallen "Dragon King's Altar." The "name" mentioned in the signal was actually the key to the outbreak of the ancient war. She knew she had to go and witness the truth of history.
UnitStory_120202_7: The final battle unfolded in the ruins of the Dragon King's Altar. Peggy faced an "Evolution Army" composed of Black Breath, machines, and elites from various races. She stood on Big Tooth's back, holding high the bone flute flowing with golden light. "All beasts return to the source, psionic resonance!" As the flute sounded, all living beings across the land let out a roar at that moment. The Mother Tree of the forest, the tides of the wetlands, and even the distant thunder joined the battle for her. After destroying the Black Breath core, Peggy finally saw the so-called "God"—an evil consciousness composed of pure Black Breath attempting to possess the remains of the Dragon King. Peggy did not hesitate to launch the ultimate sacrifice, linking her life with the wills of all beasts to form an eternal wall of purification. The Black Breath receded, and in the distance, new life began to be born within these marks, writing stories of their own...
UnitStory_410101_2: In the Waterflower Spirit settlement of the Holy Forest Council, Binglan Xuerei wandered through the splendid sea of flowers, feeling the life force of the moist earth. From a young age, she demonstrated extraordinary summoning talent, able to commune with water elements and wield powerful magic through petals and flowing water. Her soul resonated with natural energy, making her a beloved guardian of the village. “Pure water element grants me strength; I must pass on this power,” she whispered in prayer, protecting this fertile wetland. However, with the shattering of the Dragonbreath spring, the Black Breath and magical calamities spread like an epidemic, devouring her homeland. The once-rich wetland ecology was gradually poisoned and destroyed. As the mutation intensified, Binglan, as the wetland's protector, knew the task of preserving the ecosystem and purifying the contaminated crystals lay upon her shoulders—not only for the village's future but the survival of the entire plant race.
UnitStory_410101_3: Binglan entered the wetlands beyond the village but was horrified to find pollution. The once-active streams had turned murky, injured plants struggled helplessly under the Black Breath's erosion. Her heart twisted in pain; as guardian, she must do all she could to save it. “I won't let these dark shadows spread!” she gritted her teeth, determined to find the source and eradicate the root of the corruption. Taking a deep breath, she connected her mind with the water elements, beginning a powerful rune summoning. Suddenly, the air around grew unusually heavy—hidden foes seemed to watch her closely. Tension gripped her; she sensed this dark invasion was no accident but the onset of a deeper conspiracy.
UnitStory_410101_4: During the purification process, Binglan's magic shone like bright stars in the darkness. Yet she felt bound by an unseen force. Then a dark shadow appeared— a dark mage manipulating the surrounding Black Breath, evidently the source of the pollution. “You think you can stop the rise of darkness?” the mage sneered, unleashing fierce dark magic. Faced with this, Binglan's heart tightened; she knew this enemy wielded great power and a hidden plot. “I will not retreat!” she resolved, gathering energy in both hands to counterattack. The struggle between them quietly brewed. She knew for victory, she must increase her strength to finally repel the darkness.
UnitStory_410101_5: As the mage's powerful attacks drew near, Binglan summoned the water elements, swiftly forming a water shield to block the dark currents. She unleashed inner strength; countless water streams danced in the air, launching a fierce counterattack on the mage. “Water's power, become the wave of retribution!” she shouted, bolstering her belief. Instantly, water surged like a raging tide, striving to scatter the enemy's pressure. But the dark mage did not expect Binglan's elemental water power not only blocked attacks but gradually transformed into a spring of counterforce. The life force contained within water once again showed the plant race's deep love and tenacity for nature, strengthening Binglan's determination to defeat darkness.
UnitStory_410101_6: While Binglan wielded potent water elemental power, the dark mage laughed madly, casting higher-level dark magic. Instantly, a torrent of dark flame surged forward, seemingly intent on swallowing the water elements. “I won't let you succeed!” Binglan firmly replied, summoning endless water and magic forces to resist. Her hands spun water streams, holding back the foe's pressure. The clash of these mighty forces stirred incredible waves. Binglan knew she had to seize the initiative. At the critical moment, lightning streaked across the sky; inspiration flooded her mind—fusing water and lightning powers elevated her magic to its peak.
UnitStory_410101_7: Finally, focusing all her strength, Binglan unleashed a mighty wave of water impact, sweeping directly toward the mage. The dark mage's roar was drowned by the water, and the shadowy aura dissolved instantly. The dawn of victory bathed the wetlands; water elements and plant life revived anew. Neighboring grasses and trees sprouted fresh growth, and villagers glimpsed light again, feeling hope and rebirth. Binglan regrouped, realizing this victory was a response to faith in protecting home. Yet she understood many dangers still lurked on the continent. To defend this land, Binglan vowed to continue uncovering the secrets and conspiracies behind the darkness, standing with her kin to safeguard peace and survival's future. With courage and belief, Binglan Xuerei embarked on a new journey.
UnitStory_110402_2: In the Runecity of the Valen Federation, Mia Chenlu sat in the forbidden spell sect's library, holding a Flame Bell. Her curling golden hair flickered like dancing flames; her gaze firm and determined. As a young summoner, her affinity for fire elements was admired; she could easily command raging flames and nimble fire sprites. “I will use the power of fire's mysteries to protect this world,” she silently vowed. Yet this was no easy path. A past flame out of control nearly cost her everything, causing the sect to regard her as a danger. Even so, Mia persisted, transforming flame madness into protection and counterattack over years, gradually earning the sect's acceptance. Just as her summoning matured, news from the Dragonbreath fragments' scattered realms shattered her peace—fire elements stirring unnaturally signaled greater danger approaching.
UnitStory_110402_3: As the pollution from Dragonbreath fragments spread, Mia resolved to investigate the fire element anomaly's root cause. She knew these fragments possessed immense destructive power and could trigger tragic history anew. “I must find the source and prevent repetition!” she affirmed inwardly. As she gathered magic in the Flame Bell, Mia sensed a deepening bond with fire elements—the source of power but also great peril. Summoning multiple fire sprites that danced around her, she felt their anger and anxiety, confirming an underlying threat. Her intuition warned that demons might secretly plot a conspiracy against the plant race.
UnitStory_110402_4: Accompanied by her fire sprites, Mia delved into the pollution's origin, only to be confronted by a dark shadow—a dark mage manipulating fire elements, attempting to weaponize them for destruction. “You think you can stop me?” the mage's voice was biting cold, laced with mockery. Mia knew this mage was not only the polluter of fire's source but a key conspirator with the demons. “Fire shall never serve darkness!” she shouted, her indomitable spirit ablaze. Mia resolved to battle the mage, using summoning and fire sprites' strength fused with her rune technology to counterattack. Yet as confrontation began, her inner flame flared uncontrollably, seemingly betraying her will. She had to quickly steady her mind to channel power rightly.
UnitStory_110402_5: Under the dark mage's suppression, unease and urgency surged inside Mia. She concentrated, harnessing Flame Bell's energy to unleash potent fiery strikes. Alongside the fire sprites' synergy, she charged the mage; flames burned wildly around her. “The unstoppable darkness will be chased away by light!” Mia cried, unleashing strong summoning powers, her slender flame blades slicing toward the mage. But his magic grew stronger, preparing a more destructive attack. Mia felt tension tighten—she had to control her power. Recalling her family's teachings, she tamed the flame's frenzy, turning it into healing light that radiated warmly, passing hope to nearby fire sprites.
UnitStory_110402_6: After brief gathering, Mia regained flame control. Step by step, she advanced on the dark mage, feeling ancient fire's call beneath her feet. The decisive moment arrived; she poured all courage and faith into the Flame Bell. “In fire's name, feel the power of life!” she roared, releasing a mighty fire spell that burst into a fiery dragon soaring toward the dark mage, scorching the air and tearing through enemy defenses. Shadows receded at once; the mage was engulfed in blazing flames and utterly destroyed. Mia understood she was not just avenging but protecting life and future.
UnitStory_110402_7: With the dark's collapse, water elements and nature's breath freed again; tainted lands began to rejuvenate. Mia saw countless fire sprites dance joyously, sensing their relief and gladness. A deep sense of accomplishment filled her. Yet she knew this was but a victory to prevent history's replay. More challenges awaited her. To ensure darkness would never return, Mia vowed to continue exploring the deep connection between fire elements and the Dragonbreath crystals, aiming to guide this ancient power towards peace and vitality. She firmly believes her calling as a summoner was just beginning. Flames and life's power would shine anew through her hands. Fueled by ideals and faith, Mia Chenlu stepped onto the path of exploration, ready for the adventures ahead.
UnitStory_140301_2: During the turbulent times of the Shattered Continent, Groda Forestbear was born at the border between the orc tribes and the Holy Forest Council of the plant race. He bore the hopes and conflicts of both peoples, carrying orcish strength and wildness alongside the plant folk's respect for nature and deep magical heritage. His father was a warrior among the Rift orcs, his mother a sagacious flower spirit of the council—this rare mixed blood made him a symbol of peace. “No matter how hard the path, I will strive to be the bridge between two peoples,” young Groda vowed. Despite growing in a world filled with misunderstandings and strife, he firmly believed unity and coexistence were essential to repel common foes. Groda's summoning aptitude shone in childhood, enabling him to call forth the great bear spirit of the forest as his combat and guarding partner. Over time, this power deepened his bond with nature.
UnitStory_140301_3: As years passed, Groda resolved to ease tensions between orcs and plants through his strength. He often spoke at mixed tribal gatherings, urging unity and cooperation. Though sometimes misunderstood or mocked, he remained unyielding. “We share a common enemy—darkness and chaos!” This phrase became his steadfast conviction at every meeting. Yet as the Black Breath and demon invasions grew, tribal conflicts worsened, filling Groda with impending dread. During a patrol, he witnessed more and more anomalies—forest vitality waned, raising grave concern. He realized if unchecked, it threatened his homeland and loved ones.
UnitStory_140301_4: During his investigation, Groda found increasing numbers of plants and animals tainted by Black Breath. He sensed unprecedented menace, as dark forces quietly gathered and relentlessly consumed everything around. If orcs and plants clashed further, irreversible losses would follow. “I cannot stand idly by—I must find a way to restore peace!” he resolved, choosing to venture deep into the forest to seek solutions against the Black Breath. Summoning his great bear spirit, he set out together. As he embarked on the unknown path, feelings of anticipation and nervousness stirred, as if setting forth on a destined journey.
UnitStory_140301_5: Deep in the forest, Groda and his bear spirit moved through shadows and light, echoing nature's call in unison. Suddenly, hidden foes appeared—the dark shadows of demons surged in waves, the vanguard of evil. “Protect nature! Rise weapons!” Groda roared, courage and spirit swelling within. He swung his arms while the bear spirit counterattacked, sparking a breathtaking battle. Yet the enemies' numbers surpassed imagination, and unease crept into Groda's heart. Now was no moment for panic. Clutching his faith, he fought alongside nature's power. As battle went on, deeper conspiracies surfaced, unsettling his soul.
UnitStory_140301_6: After fierce struggle, Groda repelled most foes. Hidden secrets emerged—the dark assault was ruled by a powerful dark mage who masterminded the attack on both plant and orc peoples. “We must find this mage quickly and stop his plot!” Groda realized that unchecked enemy and dark forces' spread would not only wipe out a tribe but devastate the entire ecosystem. He understood his role was not just warrior but bridge of hope and unity between two peoples. He resolved to gather more allies and confront the coming challenges.
UnitStory_140301_7: In the days ahead, Groda united orcs and patient plant folk to face the dark mage. In a pivotal battle, he marshaled his bear spirit's power, working with allies to gradually corner the mage. Finally, with a thunderous roar, Groda gave his all, unleashing immense strength fused with nature's harmony, shining as the last glimmer of hope. Darkness was shattered in that instant, and vitality returned to the forest. Dawn broke on the Rift Mountains; Groda stood beside his bear spirit, heart filled with resolve. He knew greater challenges awaited but believed only unity and coexistence could resist darkness. Bearing hope and courage, he continued his journey of exploration and protection, carrying the expectation of peace forward.
UnitStory_120302_2: Maya Lingteng hails from a family in the Runecity that once delved deeply into forbidden magic. As a child, she personally witnessed her family's near-total annihilation caused by a mysterious disaster linked to the dark power over-harvested from the Dragonbreath Crystals, with only herself surviving. Orphaned, Maya was rescued by a wandering arcane mage who led her away from the curse's shadow and began teaching her necromancy and shadow magic. Over the years, she combined ancient skeletal summoning arts with rune technology, creating tactically coordinated skeleton legions. Despite others' fear and prejudice against her forbidden magic, Maya steadfastly maintained that she summoned the undead to protect the weak, not to abuse dark powers. Yet an unresolved, sinister truth behind her family's demise lingered tormentingly in her heart.
UnitStory_120302_3: During one expedition into ruins, Maya found a fragmentary rune tablet seemingly describing a demon conspiracy. Combining it with memories inherited from her clan, she vaguely perceived that her family's downfall was no accident but the result of demons manipulating the Black Breath's power. To uncover the truth, Maya decided to investigate secretly but soon attracted attention from mysterious forces. Her skeleton army was repeatedly ambushed, as if enemies sought to prevent her approach to the truth. The “Undead Guardian” faced unprecedented danger, forced to conceal her identity and navigate between human society and the arcane black market, searching for vital clues to expose the demon plot.
UnitStory_120302_4: On her dark journey, Maya met Elara Yao Man, a healer from the plant race, and Grum, a human rune scholar. Initially wary of Maya's summoning magic, they came to see her resolve to protect the weak during a battle where her skeletons repelled demon pursuers. The three formed a fragile alliance to jointly pursue the truth of the Black Breath's corrupting spread. Maya began learning how to balance darkness and light; her skeletons became not only weapons but also guardians of the allied front. The deeper she probed, the more she discovered that this magical disaster stemmed from a conspiracy far more complex and malicious.
UnitStory_120302_5: As their investigation deepened, demons noticed Maya's party and sent sharp shadow assassins to trap them. In a harrowing night assault, Maya agilely commanded the skeleton troops with calm, flexible formations and finally repelled the enemy but at a heavy cost. This battle made her realize the foes were not just demons but also Black Breath-corrupted traitors within Valen. Meanwhile, Maya uncovered that a key Dragonbreath Crystal was hidden deep inside the Runecity and that revealing it would shift the continent's power balance.
UnitStory_120302_6: Maya led her allies into the forbidden underground ruins of the Runecity to seek the legendary Dragonbreath Crystal. The labyrinth was riddled with ancient magical remnants, undead, and traps. Using her skeletons, she cleared paths and solved rune puzzles, gradually approaching the core. Suddenly, the demon main forces appeared, determined to reclaim the crystal. Maya faced a great trial; relying on wisdom and summoning, she led the skeleton army to hold their ground. Amid the intense battle, her resolve flared—she must protect this power and prevent tragedy from repeating.
UnitStory_120302_7: After the battle, Maya revealed her family's downfall secret—the demons had used Black Breath to control her kin, forcing them to mine the Dragonbreath Crystal, ultimately dooming the clan. She decided to publicize this truth, clearing her family's name and warning the world. Maya knew summoning undead carried darkness, but she chose to wield it to guard the weak and truth. Bearing a new mission, she set out to eliminate demonic corruption and purify lands tainted by Black Breath. The future light of Dragonbreath Continent might need this “Undead Guardian” to illuminate the way.
UnitStory_130603_2: Selina Shuangmei was born into an ancient noble bloodline within the demon Black Breath Cult. From childhood, she manifested frost magic and psychic control. Her charm spells combined Black Breath's demonic energies and Dragonbreath Crystal frost remnants to manipulate enemy minds, making her a deadly battlefield manipulator. Cult elders held great expectations, sending her on a difficult mission—to infiltrate the Valen Federation's core city-state and disrupt order. Facing complex human traps and defenses, Selina was calm and decisive. Her psychic charm thrown guards into confusion while she secretly gathered critical strategic intelligence. This mission tested her skills and sparked conflicted feelings about “chaos” and “order.” She thirsted for autonomy instead of being a Black Breath tool.
UnitStory_130603_3: After the mission, Selina returned intelligence to the cult but found growing internal complexity. A rebellious faction quietly rose, questioning the cult's extremism and even seeking to overthrow elders. Caught in power struggles, Selina was both executor and suspected spy. During a secret operation, she discovered rebels manipulated by forces beyond the demons—a deeper conspiracy. Alerted, she began covert investigations, navigating cult intrigues to protect herself and seek truth, searching for power to truly master her fate.
UnitStory_130603_4: During investigation, Selina suffered attacks from traitors, facing mental and physical threats. She used frost magic to freeze foes and charm to disrupt minds, escaping successfully. This trial strengthened her resolve to break Black Breath's chains and no longer be controlled by the cult. She began reconciling inner chaos and order, seeking a path to power and freedom. Her charm evolved beyond enslavement into psychic bonds with allies—dangerous yet alluring, with frost's beauty hiding unread determination.
UnitStory_130603_5: At a secret meeting, Selina learned shocking news: another demon faction had struck a dark pact with covert human forces to jointly seize Dragonbreath Crystals, overthrowing the current order. Realizing the dark game was far more complex, she knew only she could stop apocalypse. To investigate and sabotage this pact, Selina chose to secretly approach human powers, focusing on a powerful mage. She had to disguise herself using charm and wits to penetrate the core but this plunged her into deeper danger and confusion.

UnitStory_140502_0: Freena Luminous was born in the mysterious forest of the Silverglow Elven Kingdom. Her purple hair and a pair of shining green eyes highlight her innate magical talent. In her childhood, she discovered a magnificent staff deep within an ancient temple in the forest. This staff, made from the roots of a thousand-year-old ancient tree and a crystal imbued with elemental power, is said to possess great forest guardian strength. The staff is not only Freena Luminous's weapon but also her bond with nature. With this staff, she can cast breathtaking elemental magic to protect the forest and all life within it. In every battle against dark forces, the staff enhances her power, helping her heal injured creatures and restore ecological balance. As her adventure deepens, Freena Luminous gradually realizes that the staff is not just a symbol of power but also carries her mission to protect her homeland. She vows to seek lost magical knowledge and use the staff's power to bring more harmony and peace to the world.
UnitStory_410501_0: Deka Chiyan was born in the "Red Card Village" of the Dragon Breath Continent, a village famous for its unique fiery red soil. However, the village was often tormented by evil forces, causing great suffering to the villagers. When Deka Chiyan was still young, his family was attacked, and his parents tragically died protecting him. After that event, Deka Chiyan vowed to become strong. During his growth, he trained alone, practiced assassin skills, and gained much knowledge from an ancient book. This book is considered a treasured heritage passed down by the village, containing wisdom about survival and assassination. Through continuous effort, he not only improved his strength but also gradually developed a unique understanding of the essence of life. To avenge his family and protect the innocent, Deka Chiyan embarked on an adventure seeking justice. Along the way, he fought while exploring and helped solve various challenges in complex situations, becoming a well-respected assassin. His new goal is to destroy the dark forces that threaten the safety of the village and strive to rebuild the home he once lost.
UnitStory_140502_1: Freena Luminous was born in the mysterious forest of the Silverglow Elven Kingdom. Her purple hair and green eyes made the villagers recognize her innate magical talent. In her young heart, the forest was a place full of mystery and wonder. During an exploration, she accidentally discovered a magnificent staff, rumored to contain powerful natural elemental energy. However, she still had no understanding of the true meaning of this staff…
UnitStory_140502_2: As Freena Luminous grew, the staff became her most important companion. She practiced magic deep within the forest, gradually mastering the elemental powers. In a battle against beasts, the staff's power helped her successfully protect a group of injured small animals. At that moment, she realized the staff was not only a weapon but also a bond between her and nature. However, increasing dark forces began to threaten her homeland, forcing her to consider where the new challenges lay…
UnitStory_140502_3: On a calm day, dark forces invaded her forest, disrupting the ecological balance. Freena Luminous rose to fight back, wielding the staff to cast elemental magic. However, faced with ever-growing enemies, panic surged in her heart. She realized that if she continued the habitual fighting, the forest would face an even greater crisis. To find a solution, she decided to seek lost magical knowledge and began exploring ancient ruins within the forest…
UnitStory_140502_4: During her quest, Freena Luminous met an elderly elven mage. The mage told her that the true power of the staff combined with magical knowledge was the key to protecting the forest. Under the mage's guidance, Freena Luminous began learning ancient spells and magic. However, just as she was about to master the new magic, the mage mysteriously disappeared, leaving an unsolved mystery that made her feel lost about her future path.
UnitStory_140502_5: In the following adventure, Freena Luminous received an urgent call for help: a village on the other side of the forest was besieged by dark forces. She controlled the staff and swiftly rushed to rescue. During the battle, she accidentally discovered that these enemies seemed intricately connected to her destiny. A mysterious power lurking in the darkness was quietly approaching, causing her unease.
UnitStory_140502_6: After a series of challenges, Freena Luminous was gravely wounded in a major battle but gained more support and trust from her companions. Together, they formed a counterattack team, vowing to resist the invasion of the dark forces. At this time, the staff emitted a stronger radiance, and she realized that friendship and unity were the true sources of power against darkness. However, she found that one companion's true identity seemed to hold a secret, forcing her to question everything around her once again.
UnitStory_140502_7: As the battles intensified, the dark forces gradually unveiled the truth behind their motives. Freena Luminous found that this conflict was not only about protecting the forest but also the ultimate test in finding her own identity. During a late-night conversation, the staff conveyed an important message to her: “True guardian power comes from within the heart.” She must overcome her fears to truly master this power.
UnitStory_140502_8: Freena Luminous finally discovered the lair of the dark forces. Facing an unprecedentedly powerful opponent, the power deep within her soul was fully awakened. At the climax of the battle, the staff shone with dazzling light, leading her to unleash an unprecedented magical attack. However, just as victory seemed near, the dark forces' leader proposed a shocking deal involving Freena Luminous's sacrifice and the survival of the village. She had to make a choice.
UnitStory_140502_9: At the edge of the abyss after the ultimate showdown, Freena Luminous faced a significant decision about her homeland and her beliefs. Should she choose to protect the village and friends, or sacrifice everything for greater magical power? This choice would completely change her destiny. However, the power within the staff seemed to be waiting for her final blow, and how it would guide her toward an unknown future remained to be seen.
UnitStory_410501_1: Deka Chiyan was born in Red Card Village on the Dragon Breath Continent, a place known for its fiery red soil but also tormented by the Night Cult. During his childhood, a raid on the village changed his fate as he witnessed his parents die protecting him, prompting him to vow to become strong. However, hidden deeper secrets lurked, and Deka was unaware that the disaster was no accident...
UnitStory_410501_2: Rebuilding himself, Deka fled alone to the valleys outside the village and began rigorous training. He repeatedly practiced assassin skills and gradually mastered survival wisdom. By chance, he discovered an ancient book passed down in the village, detailing assassination arts and survival rules. Yet, deeper secrets seemed hidden between the pages. Can Deka unravel these lingering mysteries?
UnitStory_410501_3: After becoming the village's youngest assassin, Deka decided to infiltrate the Night Cult secretly. Using an alias, he carried out assassination missions. After a successful operation, he unexpectedly rescued a captive villager, who revealed the cult's plan for a large-scale attack. Deka realized mere revenge would not save the village; a greater threat awaited.
UnitStory_410501_4: To stop the Night Cult's conspiracy, Deka began recruiting other warriors from the village, forming a revenge team. During a counter-attack, the team suffered heavy assault, and members began questioning Deka's decisions. His confidence was challenged—could he regain the team's trust and morale to move forward?
UnitStory_410501_5: After arduous missions, Deka finally located the Night Cult's base and prepared a comprehensive counterattack plan with his teammates. Yet, impending battle brought panic, with a traitor in their midst threatening to shatter everything. On the eve of the confrontation, he felt his feelings toward the team grow complicated—could he overcome inner doubts and face the coming challenge?
UnitStory_410501_6: Before the decisive battle, Deka faced the traitor. Seeking the truth behind betrayal, he discovered ties to his past pain. Inner struggles made his decision hard: revenge or forgiveness? This dilemma would be resolved when the outcome was decided.
UnitStory_410501_7: Battle commenced as Deka led the team deep into the Night Cult's heart for fierce fighting. Facing wave after wave of attacks, crises loomed, but recalling his parents' courage reignited his fighting spirit. Could he find the key amidst despair to save his team and village?
UnitStory_410501_8: The battle climaxed with enemies growing stronger and the team severely battered. At this moment, Deka uncovered the cult's core secret: their true goal was to control Red Card Village's history. While seeking truth, Deka faced a choice—to continue fighting or reveal secrets, plunging into a more complex scenario.
UnitStory_410501_9: With the battle concluded, Deka defeated the Night Cult, only to discover a larger conspiracy lurking behind. A more powerful mastermind's force went beyond the village, involving the entire Dragon Breath Continent. Facing unknown enemies and grander war, how would Deka choose his fate?

UnitStory_150501_1: The oldest military banner of the Varen Federation has always borne the image of Athena holding a spear and raising a shield. Before she was revered as the Goddess of War and Guardianship, she was a human commander. At the beginning of the Shard Era, she led the survivors in rebuilding their city-state, quelled disputes with unwavering resolve, and defended the city gate alone for seven days when the Black Breath army laid siege to the city. In the final battle, Athena used her own body to withstand the power of an out-of-control Dragon Breath crystal. In response to her conviction to protect everyone, the Dragon Breath coalesced into an immortal divinity, forging the Sunwheel Sacred Shield and the Spear of Judgment. From then on, she became a symbol of order and courage for humanity. Now, as the Black Breath spreads once more, the war drums long silent within the temple resound again. Athena personally takes to the battlefield, uniting the allied forces with her dignified authority and inspiring her companions with unreserved passion. She firmly believes that true gods should not sit high above the heavens, but stand before the people.
UnitStory_150501_2: At the beginning of the Shard Era, Athena had not yet become a goddess. In the ruins of Varen, she encountered Grum, who was leading survivors in search of food. The two initially argued over the distribution of supplies. Athena insisted on saving the wounded first, while Grum feared that the weak would bring everyone down. When monsters raided the camp at night, Athena held the front while Grum led a group in a surprise attack through the underground sewers. After their victory, they merged their respective groups and jointly established the first refuge city. From then on, Grum called her “the woman who will never retreat,” while Athena regarded him as the civilian leader she trusted most.
UnitStory_150501_3: When the Black Breath army besieged the fledgling city-state, Athena led the defenders in holding the city gate. Elena and Serena were still merely young, ordinary knights at the time, yet they refused the order to retreat and voluntarily stayed behind to assist her. During the seven days of fierce fighting, Elena repaired the city gate with her ancestral Dragon Breath runes, while Serena repeatedly rallied the scattered soldiers and led them back to the defensive line. After reinforcements arrived, Athena personally bestowed upon them the titles of Radiant Knight and Knight of Light. She told them that a knight’s glory does not come from bloodline, but from choosing to stand before others despite knowing fear. The two thus became the most steadfast inheritors of Athena’s spirit.
UnitStory_150501_4: The Dragon Breath crystal beneath Varen suddenly went out of control. Brog was responsible for performing the Stone-Calming Ritual, while Durin led the artisans in constructing a sealing device. However, the crystal’s power far exceeded expectations, and the seal was about to collapse. Athena ordered everyone to evacuate and entered the core alone with her shield raised. Unwilling to abandon her, Brog infused the shield with the blessing of the Stoneheart God, while Durin drove the final stabilizing rune into her armor. Athena ultimately bore the Dragon Breath within her own body and condensed it into the Sunwheel Divinity. After becoming a goddess, she did not accept their prostrations, but first thanked the two of them, for she knew well that a so-called miracle is never the work of one person alone.
UnitStory_150501_5: Humans and orcs were on the verge of war over a mineral vein when Mitia brought intelligence proving that the demons had deliberately instigated the conflict. Athena followed her into the rift valley, where they encountered Karl, who was responsible for guarding his tribe. Distrustful of humans, Karl demanded that Athena undergo the Trial of the Wolf Spirit. She passed the trial through her own strength, but instead of taking the totem that symbolized victory, she returned it to the tribe. The three then joined forces to track the demon scouts and exposed the Black Breath Cult’s conspiracy. Karl acknowledged her courage as a result, while Mitia began serving as a secret liaison between the Federation and the orcs.
UnitStory_150501_6: Rayne, a human-dragon hybrid, was deemed a potential threat by the Federation Council after losing control of his power. Some nobles demanded that Athena execute him, while Serena firmly believed that Rayne could still control himself. On the day of the trial, Athena did not sit upon her divine throne, but personally fought Rayne. She endured his dragonfire with her sacred shield, forcing him to confront the fear within his heart and ultimately helping him regain control of his power. Athena declared that bloodline cannot determine a person’s guilt or glory. This act provoked intense discontent among the conservatives, but it allowed Rayne to become a guardian linking humanity and the dragon race, and strengthened Serena’s resolve to follow Athena.
UnitStory_150501_7: When the Black Breath Cult launched a massive assault on the Dragon Breath Rift, Athena summoned heroes of every race to form a united army. Grum coordinated supplies, Lia purified the corruption, Viliana led the elven archers in suppressing the demons, and Elena and Serena defended the central battle line. Faced with the storm of black flames summoned by Livia, the armies of the various races briefly fell into chaos. Athena drove the Sunwheel Sacred Shield into the earth, using its divine light to show everyone the way, and entrusted the final assault to her companions. After the battle, she refused to claim the victory for herself and declared that every participant was a founder of the new order. For the first time, all races truly acknowledged her position as the leader of the alliance.
UnitStory_150401_1: An ancient legend has long been passed down in the Silverglow Kingdom: whenever the moonlight is tainted by the Black Breath, the guardian sleeping within the Sacred Laurel Forest will awaken. Artemis is the legendary Goddess of the Moon Hunt. During the War of the Gods, she exhausted her divine power to protect the ancestors of the elves, and her shattered divinity caused her to lose most of her memories. When she awakened again, she still possessed the divine bow capable of commanding moonlight and tracking prey, but had become a mischievous, cheerful girl who frequently forgot things. When the Black Breath began searching for the fragments of her divinity scattered across the continent, Artemis eagerly set out on her journey. She would forget maps, names, and the details of her missions, so she had no choice but to carve important promises into the fletching of her arrows. Even so, she never forgot to protect the weak, for while the body may forget, her divine nature always remembers where the arrow should fly.
UnitStory_150401_2: When the Black Breath invaded the Sacred Laurel Forest, Viliana was ordered by the royal court to investigate. Deep within the Moonlit Spring, she discovered the sleeping Artemis and the Moonbow suspended from the divine tree. Demons suddenly attacked, and Viliana fought them alone, only to be overwhelmed by corrupted crystals. At the critical moment, Artemis awakened from her long slumber. She used the light arrow fired by Viliana to locate the enemy, then shattered the Black Breath core with a single moonlight arrow. Unable to remember her own identity, she even called the stern Viliana “the glowing archer big sister.” Viliana corrected her helplessly, but also became the first person Artemis trusted after awakening.
UnitStory_150401_3: Fearing that Artemis’s incomplete divinity might go out of control, the Arcane Council dispatched Lias, an assassin of the Silver Moon, to watch her in secret. Artemis quickly noticed the person following her, but deliberately led Lias in circles through the forest and even left behind an arrow inscribed with “You’re not hiding well enough.” During the chase, the two accidentally discovered that the Black Breath Cult was transporting corrupted crystals into the kingdom. Artemis created a diversion while Lias infiltrated the camp to obtain intelligence, and together they ultimately destroyed the convoy. After the mission, Lias continued to insist that she was only an observer, yet quietly began recording the journeys Artemis had forgotten.
UnitStory_150401_4: While searching for fragments of her divinity, Artemis became lost in a swamp and happened to encounter Mitia, who was tracking demon scouts. Mitia found her unbearably noisy, yet had no choice but to rely on her moonlight arrows to disperse the poisonous fog. The two were then surrounded by demons. Artemis deliberately shot through a dead tree, unleashing the swamp waters to wash away the enemy camp, while Mitia used the chaos to recover the intelligence. On their way back to the outpost, Artemis completely forgot the correct route and led them back to where they had started. Mitia was so furious that she drew her dagger, but ultimately could not help laughing. From then on, she became Artemis’s most reluctant yet most reliable guide.
UnitStory_150401_5: Artemis overused her divine power to save a group of children, and when she awakened, she had forgotten Viliana and Lias. Ella Herbvine, the young healing sage, attempted to brew a potion that would restore her memory, while Lia used life magic to stabilize her shattered divinity. The potion could only restore her memories briefly, forcing Artemis to decide which one she wished to preserve. She did not choose the story of her own divine past, but instead chose to remember the names of her companions. Ella therefore created flower seeds capable of recording voices for her, while Lias began carving their shared experiences into the fletching of her arrows. From that moment on, forgetting was no longer a fear she had to face alone.
UnitStory_150401_6: Selina the succubus found an intact fragment of the Moon Goddess’s divinity and offered to restore all of Artemis’s memories in exchange for the location of the Silverglow Kingdom’s crystals. The voice within the divinity constantly tempted her, promising to make her a powerful and perfect goddess once again. Lias tried to stop the exchange, but fell under Selina’s control. Artemis pretended to agree, then fired a moonlight arrow concealed in her sleeve the instant she touched the divinity, severing the mind control. In the end, she sealed the fragment and took only the power required to free Lias. Selina mocked her for choosing to remain incomplete, but Artemis replied: “I’ve forgotten many things, but I still remember that friends must never be used in a trade.”
UnitStory_150401_7: When Livia unleashed a colossal black-flame beast against the allied army, Artemis fought beside Athena for the first time. The beast could devour magical power, and neither Athena’s divine spear nor the moonlight arrows could pierce its shell. Artemis suddenly thought of using the Sunwheel Sacred Shield to reflect the moonlight, but forgot the exact angle as they prepared to act. Viliana immediately marked the trajectory with a light arrow, while Serena led the knights in buying them time. At last, sunlight, moonlight, and elven light converged into a single arrow that pierced the beast’s core. After the battle, Artemis carved the names of Athena and the others into her arrow fletching and officially became a member of the United Army of Order.

TravelEventDesc_1001: You have stepped into the <color=#FF6B6B>Bone Burial Ground</color>, a place filled with endless danger and opportunity
TravelEventDesc_1002: You pass through a town that seems to have just experienced a <color=#FFD700>Magic War</color>; ruins are everywhere, and the air is thick with violent magical energy. You hastily leave the area
TravelEventDesc_1003: You encounter an elf whose home is inside a towering old tree, where glowing <color=#FF69B4>pollen</color> floats everywhere
TravelEventDesc_1004: Her pointed ears twitch as she looks up and blows a handful of yellow glowing pollen toward you
TravelEventDesc_1005: You gain the <color=#6AFF96>Natural Affinity</color> of the Elven race
TravelEventDesc_1006: You find a <color=#8A2BE2>human</color> camp, but it is deserted
TravelEventDesc_1007: You rest overnight in the camp
TravelEventDesc_1008: At the foot of the mountain, you see someone on the peak; soon a huge <color=#00BFFF>magic circle</color> forms
TravelEventDesc_1009: You meet a shaman in the forest who gives you an <color=#FF4500>apple</color>
TravelEventDesc_1010: After much hesitation, you eat it, but nothing seems to happen
TravelEventDesc_1011: You encountered a <color=#FF9B05>circus</color> performing, and the circus envoy invited you to join tonight's show
TravelEventDesc_1012: You participated in the show and received praise from many; the envoy gifted you his <color=#759AE5>magical flame</color>
TravelEventDesc_1013: You met a resting <color=#759AE5>caravan</color> and traded your wild fruits for hot soup
TravelEventDesc_1014: You came across villagers repairing a bridge in the village and helped them carry timber
TravelEventDesc_1015: In gratitude, they gifted you a <color=#FF9B05>life fruit</color>
TravelEventDesc_1016: You found a torn <color=#FF9B05>map</color> on the road; although incomplete, you now know the general direction
TravelEventDesc_1017: In the jungle, you discovered a <color=#FF9B05>small snake</color> appearing near death; you chose to rescue it, but soon heard hissing sounds all around
TravelEventDesc_1018: Turning around, you saw many snakes approaching, but they didn't attack; they raised their heads and exhaled a cloud of green mist toward you
TravelEventDesc_1019: You obtained the serpent tribe's <color=#FF9B05>green mist shield</color>
TravelEventDesc_1020: You discovered an ancient <color=#759AE5>skeleton demon</color> seemingly summoning you
TravelEventDesc_1021: You begin to pray for runes in front of him, gradually feeling an incredible power surge within you.
TravelEventDesc_1023: By the roadside, you saw a strange <color=#FF9B05>wraith group</color> seemingly performing a strange ritual
TravelEventDesc_1024: After they left, you approached and touched an ancient rune-covered stone tablet on the ground; vines pierced your fingertip and absorbed your blood
TravelEventDesc_1025: You obtained <color=#FF9B05>thorn protection</color>, granting a 20% chance to reflect 30% damage when hit
TravelEventDesc_1026: You noticed strange footprints on the lake shore, seemingly left by a huge creature
TravelEventDesc_1027: Looking up, you saw a giant <color=#759AE5>stone spirit</color> raising its head and throwing a rock at you
TravelEventDesc_1028: You picked it up and found you obtained <color=#759AE5>stone spirit power</color>
TravelEventDesc_1029: In the forest, you discovered an abandoned small cabin and found a rusty <color=#FF9B05>iron shield</color>
TravelEventDesc_1030: You polished it and strapped it to your arm
TravelEventDesc_1031: In the desert, feeling very thirsty, you met a strange <color=#759AE5>wizard</color>
TravelEventDesc_1032: He gave you a strangely colored <color=#759AE5>water bottle</color>; after considering it, you drank it but nothing seemed to happen
TravelEventDesc_1033: At a shaky broken bridge, you paused pondering how to cross when you saw a strange <color=#FF9B05>knight</color> on the other side
TravelEventDesc_1034: He released his <color=#FF9B05>chains</color> and built a temporary bridge for you to cross; you thanked him
TravelEventDesc_1035: In a mine cave, you met a strange <color=#759AE5>stone golem</color> who looked at you and exhaled gray gas
TravelEventDesc_1036: You felt a strange power arise within your body
TravelEventDesc_1037: You met a plainly dressed <color=#FF9B05>elder</color> who shared his perspective on the kingdom's history
TravelEventDesc_1038: In the forest, you encountered a strange <color=#759AE5>mist</color>; unable to see clearly, you were attacked and injured by an unknown creature
TravelEventDesc_1039: In the village, you met a <color=#759AE5>blacksmith</color> who repaired your weapon, making it as sharp as new
TravelEventDesc_1040: At dusk, you met a <color=#FF9B05>witch</color> who told you the origins of witches
TravelEventDesc_1041: You discovered an uninhabited <color=#759AE5>wooden cabin</color>; after searching, you found nothing
TravelEventDesc_1042: Passing by a crystal cave, you collected many <color=#FF9B05>crystal shards</color>
TravelEventDesc_1043: You passed an abandoned temple and found many supplies while inspecting the <color=#759AE5>altar</color>
TravelEventDesc_1044: At a cliff edge, a <color=#FF9B05>strong wind</color> almost knocked you down, but you grabbed a nearby tree branch
TravelEventDesc_1045: In a mining cave, you found a hot spring; after tossing in a stone, a <color=#759AE5>magic circle</color> formed shortly after
TravelEventDesc_1046: At night, while resting, you were bitten by <color=#FF9B05>mosquitoes</color> in the forest, making you feel irritated
TravelEventDesc_1047: You passed a flower field where suddenly a <color=#759AE5>flower spirit</color> appeared and blocked your path; after explaining your intentions, it gave you a pink-glowing petal
TravelEventDesc_1048: You gained the flower spirit's <color=#759AE5>blossom buff</color>
TravelEventDesc_1049: On the road, you met a <color=#FF9B05>beast tamer</color> who asked you to help find his lost beasts
TravelEventDesc_1050: In the jungle depths, you discovered an ancient <color=#759AE5>treasure chest</color>; opening it, you found it empty
TravelEventDesc_1051: In a small town, you met a lone <color=#FF9B05>soldier</color> who told you stories of the army
TravelEventDesc_1052: By the lake, you met a wandering poet who chatted happily with you and sang you a <color=#FF9B05>wilderness ballad</color>
TravelEventDesc_1053: Passing a village, the warm-hearted <color=#759AE5>villagers</color> invited you to dinner
TravelEventDesc_1054: You saw a trapped elf wrapped in vines at the edge of the swamp. After helping him get free, she presented you with a <color=#FF9B05>rune</color>.
TravelEventDesc_1055: You met a <color=#759AE5>vine</color> walking forward continuously; after asking, you learned it would accompany you for a while, during which you both enjoyed the journey
TravelEventDesc_2001: On the hillside, you see a <color=#6AFF96>green light</color>; upon touching it, you feel as if you have gained some mysterious power
TravelEventDesc_2002: You come across an orc blacksmith whose furnace burns with <color=#8A2BE2>purple flames</color>; he reforges your weapons and armor
TravelEventDesc_2003: You find a mirror that claims you are the strongest... creature in the world. You feel confident but something seems off
TravelEventDesc_2004: Feeling very hungry, you eat some fruit you find. One strange fruit makes your limbs become <color=#FF6347>rubbery</color>, able to stretch freely; it takes two days to recover

TravelEventDesc_2006: Walking through the desert, you are very thirsty and find a clear spring; drinking from it strengthens your <color=#FF6B13B>vitality</color>
TravelEventDesc_2007: You meet a seasoned beast soldier and spar with him, learning some <color=#4682B4>combat techniques</color>
TravelEventDesc_2008: You discover an opened treasure chest containing a bottle of <color=#DC143C>strength potion</color>
TravelEventDesc_2009: A yellow-haired person shouts “Will of Fire” as he charges at you and hands you a <color=#FFA500>skill scroll</color>
TravelEventDesc_2010: You find a huge <color=#6B8E23>pumpkin</color> that takes three days to finish eating; afterward, your body seems to undergo a transformation
TravelEventDesc_2011: You discovered an ancient altar carved with runes at the mountaintop; suddenly struck by lightning, your body glowed blue, and you gained <color=#759AE5>Lightning Enchantment</color>, giving your weapon a 10% chance to paralyze enemies on attack
TravelEventDesc_2012: Under the moonlit night, you encountered a translucent wolf pack surrounding you; by offering the raw meat you carried, you unlocked the <color=#FF9B05>Shadow Pact</color>, allowing you to summon a ghost wolf for scouting once every 5 days
TravelEventDesc_2013: You picked up an hourglass with flowing sand reversed by the roadside; as the sand seeped into your skin, you activated <color=#759AE5>Time Rewind</color>, increasing your maximum health
TravelEventDesc_2014: Deep in the forest, you saw a blindfolded stone statue continuously shedding tears; touching his <color=#FF9B05>tears</color>with your hand, you felt a change within your body
TravelEventDesc_2015: Feeling a bit hungry, you found some <color=#FF9B05>mushrooms</color>to eat, but suddenly felt dizzy; after a while, you regained clarity and realized your attack power had increased
TravelEventDesc_2016: You met a talking ancient tree and chatted with him for a while; he gifted you a <color=#759AE5>power fruit</color>
TravelEventDesc_2017: While wandering near a lake, you discovered a group of glowing small fish; upon approaching and touching them, you felt as if you had gained some <color=#FF9B05>mysterious power</color>
TravelEventDesc_2018: You walked through the mountains and saw a group of controlled <color=#759AE5>puppets</color>; following them, you arrived at a small cabin and found many supplies
TravelEventDesc_2019: You found a magnificent building that seemed deserted; after searching inside, you obtained many <color=#FF9B05>supplies</color>
TravelEventDesc_2020: You stumbled upon a mysterious book, seemingly a <color=#759AE5>magic tome</color>; by reading it, you improved your combat skills
TravelEventDesc_3001: You find a backpack wedged in a crack beside a <color=#A0522D>cliff</color>
TravelEventDesc_3002: A rope is tied to the rock, the other end hanging down the <color=#A0522D>cliff</color>; you don't know what happened
TravelEventDesc_3003: While searching for supplies, a fiery <color=#B22222>big bird</color> attacks you
TravelEventDesc_3004: Suddenly a <color=#7B68EE>thick fog</color> appears around you, obscuring all sight
TravelEventDesc_3005: A dagger-wielding creature suddenly emerges from your shadow
TravelEventDesc_3006: A group of weak <color=#6B8E23>skeleton soldiers</color> slowly approach you
TravelEventDesc_3008: You discover a band of wandering imps
TravelEventDesc_3009: You encounter a <color=#4B0082>ghost</color> that appears to be devouring its own kind
TravelEventDesc_3010: A frail beast soldier blocks your way wielding an axe
TravelEventDesc_3011: A knight shouts “Charge! Charge!” as he rushes toward you; you must take up your weapon to fight
TravelEventDesc_3012: After defeating him, you obtain a horse wearing armor; now travel won't be tiring
TravelEventDesc_3013: Tired, you sit on a giant rock; suddenly the rock moves
TravelEventDesc_3014: It is a stone golem, disturbed from its slumber. You have no choice but to fight it
TravelEventDesc_3015: You see a minotaur dozing by a campfire—perfect for a surprise attack
TravelEventDesc_3016: When attacked, the minotaur stands up; you realize it's the minotaur chief
TravelEventDesc_3017: Its rising shadow makes you feel nightfall; you fight while retreating
TravelEventDesc_3018: A human carrying an alchemy flask suddenly chases you, saying “Care for a drink?”
TravelEventDesc_3019: A floating <color=#DC143C>statue</color> approaches, its staff glowing with elemental light; it looks hostile
TravelEventDesc_3020: You sleep in the forest but suddenly hear many wolf howls
TravelEventDesc_3021: You gather strength to face the wolf pack
TravelEventDesc_3022: A group of masked skeletons dance their way toward you, seemingly performing a ritual
TravelEventDesc_3024: While moving through the forest, you were surrounded by a murderous aura; sensing danger, you observed your surroundings and found a strange <color=#FF9B05>witch</color>
TravelEventDesc_3025: Under the full moon, while walking in the desert, the weapon in your hand suddenly emitted a red glow
TravelEventDesc_3026: A <color=#759AE5>skeleton soldier</color> suddenly crawled out from the sand and launched an attack on you
TravelEventDesc_3027: A <color=#FF9B05>soldier</color> wielding strange vines suddenly approached you, accelerating as he charged forward
TravelEventDesc_3028: In the forest, you encountered a strange tree spirit that suddenly extended its <color=#759AE5>vines</color> to attack you
TravelEventDesc_3029: A group of red-eyed soldiers suddenly attacked you; as you were puzzled, you spotted a <color=#FF9B05>witch</color> controlling them from behind
TravelEventDesc_3030: A <color=#759AE5>human beast tamer</color> suddenly started attacking you, saying, "Only I am the strongest"
TravelEventDesc_3031: Just as you finished the previous battle and prepared to rest, you heard strange footsteps
TravelEventDesc_3032: It turned out to be a group of <color=#FF9B05>beast soldiers</color>, forcing you to continue fighting
TravelEventDesc_3033: A human bone suddenly fell at your feet; a watchful <color=#759AE5>cannibal tribe</color> member stared at you and approached
TravelEventDesc_3034: With no choice, you had to confront it
TravelEventDesc_3035: You discovered a group of strange <color=#FF9B05>puppets</color> jumping toward you continuously
TravelEventDesc_3036: A strange sound suddenly pierced the night sky, seemingly from some beast tribe; looking back, you saw a crimson-eyed <color=#759AE5>ghost wolf</color> attacking you
TravelEventDesc_3037: While picking fruit from a tree, the <color=#FF9B05>roots</color> suddenly surged and revealed themselves to be awakened spirits; you were forced to fight
TravelEventDesc_3038: A strange <color=#759AE5>knight</color> blocked your path and said, "If you want to pass, you have to get through me"
TravelEventDesc_3039: The sound of a <color=#FF9B05>wraith group</color> drew nearer; realizing the area was open with no place to hide, you had no choice but to attack first
TravelEventDesc_3040: Passing by a temple, you found an unidentified <color=#759AE5>scroll</color>; as you opened and read it, someone suddenly appeared to snatch it, saying, "That can only be mine"
TravelEventDesc_3041: Through a fog, an unknown monster suddenly attacked; after fighting around, you revealed its true form—a drunk <color=#FF9B05>dark knight</color>
TravelEventDesc_3042: You accidentally entered a rock giant formation; a <color=#759AE5>rock giant monster</color> suddenly appeared, forcing your exhausted self to continue fighting
TravelEventDesc_3043: While crossing a swamp on floating wood, you were dragged underwater by tentacles; opening your eyes, you saw a <color=#FF9B05>giant octopus monster</color>
TravelEventDesc_3044: Feeling very hungry, you saw a beehive in a garden; as you prepared to collect honey, you turned around and found a <color=#759AE5>bee queen monster</color> taller than you
TravelEventDesc_3045: Climbing in a thunderstorm, your pickaxe dropped, triggering a lightning strike; <color=#FF9B05>electric rock lizards</color> swarmed and charged at you
TravelEventDesc_3046: While searching for water and about to drink, you felt a chill on your back; turning around, a <color=#759AE5>giant loach</color> was casting a spell to attack you
TravelEventDesc_3047: Passing by a sacrificial stone formation, you accidentally triggered a mechanism by touching a blood groove on a pillar; a <color=#FF9B05>hawk</color> suddenly swooped down at you
TravelEventDesc_3048: You found a frozen altar; casting a spell to open it drew the attention of a pack of <color=#759AE5>dark ice wolves</color> baring their fangs as they charged
TravelEventDesc_3049: In front of you stood a strange <color=#FF9B05>puppet squad</color>; curious, you stepped forward to inspect, but a snapped twig alerted them, forcing you to fight
TravelEventDesc_4001: You try to trap prey but fall into your own trap, suffering serious injuries...
TravelEventDesc_4002: You discover a small town; as you approach, you are mistaken for an invader and tied up, nearly thrown into a boiling pot
TravelEventDesc_4003: You trespass into the sea monster's territory; piercing screams almost burst your eardrums
TravelEventDesc_4004: The wild night is very cold and you catch a cold unexpectedly
TravelEventDesc_4005: In the <color=#7B68EE>thick fog</color> of night, you face a shadow figure nervously all night, only to discover at dawn it was a mirror
TravelEventDesc_4006: You stumble into a cannibal tribe and nearly become their dinner
TravelEventDesc_4007: Passing through a village, a hunter nearly shoots you, mistaking you for prey
TravelEventDesc_4008: Walking in the mountains, you suddenly step on a bear trap
TravelEventDesc_4009: You felt thirsty and had just found a water source when you accidentally fell into the river, causing your health to decrease
TravelEventDesc_4010: You passed by a temple; thinking no one was there and preparing to rest, you were ambushed by temple guards who mistook you for a thief, suffering heavy injuries
TravelEventDesc_4011: Feeling very hungry, you searched for and ate some wild fruits but discovered they were <color=#759AE5>shrinking fruits</color>, taking a whole day to recover
TravelEventDesc_4012: You traveled through a <color=#FF9B05>thunderstorm</color>, sustaining severe injuries
TravelEventDesc_5001: Fortune smiles upon you as you discover a <color=#FF6B6B>Lucky Treasure</color>
TravelEventDesc_5002: A <color=#FF6B6B>Thunderstorm</color> descends, lightning wildly dances in the sky. You feel enlightened and master a <color=#FF6B6B>new skill</color>
TravelEventDesc_5003: You find a <color=#6AFF96><color=#228B22>Giant's Ruins</color></color>; the majestic architecture makes you feel small
TravelEventDesc_5004: You catch a glimpse of the legendary <color=#FF6B6B><color=#FF69B4>Elven King</color></color> passing in the distance
TravelEventDesc_5005: You rescue an injured elf who turns out to be the elven princess; she invites you to a grand feast
TravelEventDesc_5006: You dream of a pirate named "<color=#FF1493>Roger</color>" who says he stored all his <color=#FF8C00>treasures</color> on an island at the edge of the sea
TravelEventDesc_5007: Upon waking, piles of treasure fill your room
TravelEventDesc_5008: You found a strange altar in the abandoned temple. After searching, you discovered it was full of <color=#FF9B05>secret manuals</color> about combat skills
TravelEventDesc_5009: You discovered some strange <color=#759AE5>ruins</color>. Upon investigation, you found them to be ancient ruins of the Dragon Breath Continent, an ancient civilization bringing you great gains
TravelEventDesc_5010: Passing through a cave, your curiosity led you to explore and find a <color=#FF9B05>hot spring</color>. After bathing, you found that your HP was fully restored
TravelEventDesc_5011: While passing an abandoned mine, your curiosity led you inside to find a rusty iron box containing a <color=#759AE5>miner's journal</color>, which recorded weapon maintenance methods that greatly benefited you
TravelEventDesc_5012: A strange witch blocked your path and asked if you could pick up a <color=#FF9B05>staff</color> on the ground for her. After you picked it up, the witch disappeared, leaving only the words “This is yours now”
TravelEventDesc_6002: It is a <color=#FF6B6B>magical fox</color> caught in a cage
TravelEventDesc_6003: The magical fox looks at you gratefully and offers some <color=#6AFF96>battle horns</color>
TravelEventDesc_6004: You discover a tribe whose people are resisting an invasion
TravelEventDesc_6005: You help suppress the invaders, and the tribe gifts you <color=#6AFF96>battle horns</color> in gratitude

1.When the <color=#D6851E>designated hero reaches the corresponding level</color>, you can purchase an exclusive gift pack and claim free rewards

Unit_HeroSummon_Instruct3: 1. Consume 10 [Hero Summon Tickets] to perform a [Hero Summon]&2. Each [Hero Summon] grants 1 Banner EXP. When Banner EXP is full, the Banner Level increases, allowing you to get better summon rewards and increasing the probability of high-tier rewards&3. Earn 1 Lucky Chest after completing a certain number of [Hero Summons]. As the Banner Level increases, Lucky Chests have a chance to drop additional rare items&4. You can view summon probabilities in the Reward Preview
